svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 1 — "The Lens" — Section 1 opens
svg.desc: Page 1: 5 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / wide-narrow). Issue 7 opens at the wall-cavity camp. Wren projects a copper-gold holographic lighthouse cross-section and leads the most complex briefing yet — a Fresnel lens swap. Squad arranged in semicircle. Sable arms folded apart, distant. Jink perched higher beam. Thresh sits with weapon. Luma studies through holographic lenses. Mid-page Wren expands the Fresnel lens detail and explains military-grade optics for the temporal drive. Sable asks tactical questions clipped, no warmth. Wren projects a mission timeline beside the lighthouse — two-phase op, Theodore daytime first. Jink leans forward and volunteers to escort Theodore — a choice not an order, the friendship pulling them.
